:::{#thm-diff-means-lincom}

#### Difference in means as a linear combination of coefficients

Let $\vx$ and $\vxs$ be two covariate patterns,
and let $\diffvx \eqdef \vx - \vxs$ be their difference.
In a linear regression model with coefficient vector $\vb$,
the difference in means $\Delta \mu \eqdef \mu(\vx) - \mu(\vxs)$ is:

$$\Delta \mu = \dprodf{\diffvx}{\vb}$$

:::

::: proof

This proof is the solution to @exr-diff-means-as-lincom, worked in @sol-diff-means-as-lincom.

:::
